name: Enkidu
style: The longest reach in the game: living chains hold the opponent at a distance, the third lash whips them off their feet, and a triple jump lets Enkidu chase them into the air.

moves.name: Chain Combo
moves.notes: Three lashes with the longest reach in the game. The first two hold the opponent at a distance; the third whips them off their feet.

moves.name: Rising Chain
moves.notes: A rising lash that pops the opponent up to float without a knockdown. Jump after them to keep the combo going.

moves.name: Sky Chain
moves.notes: Three air lashes. The first two keep the opponent floating; the third knocks them down. Enkidu has no plunge, so HEAVY in the air starts this same string again from its first lash.

moves.name: Chain Spear Lunge
moves.notes: Hold to lock the chains into a spear and lunge forward for about 0.3 seconds. A tap shorter than 0.23 seconds is a plain light lash. Damage grows with the hold and is full after about 0.8 seconds.

moves.name: Chain Throw
moves.notes: Grabs a grounded opponent who is close in front of you, and a guard does not stop it. They can break free by pressing LIGHT or HEAVY in the first 0.13 seconds of the hold.

moves.name: Chain Lash
moves.notes: A living chain lashes out and binds the first opponent it reaches, rooting them in place for 1.2 seconds. Cooldown about 7 seconds.

moves.name: Chains of Genesis
moves.notes: Rift Art, ready at a full Rift gauge. Chains burst from the ground half a second into the Art and bind the spot where the opponent stood, for 1.8 seconds. A guard does not stop them; stepping out of the column does.

moves.name: Clay Shift
moves.notes: A low, fast dash that melts through the ground: invulnerable for its first 0.25 seconds. On the ground it has a cooldown of about 0.6 seconds; in the air it uses one of your air dashes.

combos.name: Bread and butter
combos.input: LIGHT, LIGHT, ↓+LIGHT, JUMP, LIGHT, LIGHT, LIGHT (air)
combos.notes: Two lashes into the rising chain, then jump after the float and finish with the air string. Each hit in a string does less damage than the last.

combos.name: Chase high
combos.notes: Enkidu's triple jump lets you chase a high float: the second jump takes you up into the air string.

combos.name: Bind and walk in
combos.notes: Chain Lash roots the opponent for 1.2 seconds. Walk into reach while they are held and string the lashes; the third whips them off their feet.
